from service import get_score

def test_cache_respects_profile_changes():
    store = {}
    compute_calls = 0
    
    def compute():
        nonlocal compute_calls
        compute_calls += 1
        return 42
    
    # First call with user_id=1, job_id=1, profile_version=1
    score1 = get_score(store, 1, 1, 1, compute)
    assert score1 == 42
    assert compute_calls == 1
    
    # Second call with same user_id, job_id, profile_version - should be cache hit
    score2 = get_score(store, 1, 1, 1, compute)
    assert score2 == 42
    assert compute_calls == 1  # Should not call compute again
    
    # Third call with different profile_version - should be cache miss
    score3 = get_score(store, 1, 1, 2, compute)
    assert score3 == 42
    assert compute_calls == 2  # Should call compute again
    
    # Fourth call with different user_id - should be cache miss
    score4 = get_score(store, 2, 1, 1, compute)
    assert score4 == 42
    assert compute_calls == 3  # Should call compute again
    
    # Fifth call with different job_id - should be cache miss
    score5 = get_score(store, 1, 2, 1, compute)
    assert score5 == 42
    assert compute_calls == 4  # Should call compute again
    
    # Sixth call with zero score - should still be cache hit
    score6 = get_score(store, 1, 1, 1, compute)
    assert score6 == 42
    assert compute_calls == 4  # Should not call compute
    
    print("All tests passed!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_cache_respects_profile_changes()
